GM Crop Research Facility Inaugurated in Punjab

A Green Forge facility for genetically modified (GM) crop research was inaugurated in Punjab. The facility was set up by the Centre and is intended for climate simulation research related to GM crops. This development marks a step in advancing agricultural research within India.
